plan.notes: Source: official Maricopa Community Colleges district pathway map for 'Associate in Science, Emphasis in Computer Science' (Academic Plan Code 8601, DEG), Effective Term Fall 2026, retrieved 2026-09-30 from https://www.paradisevalley.edu/degrees-certificates/computer-and-information-technology/associate-science-emphasis-computer-science-8601-as. This is a districtwide plan (students may need courses at more than one Maricopa college). All course titles and prerequisite text are verbatim from the official pathway map. CREDIT RANGES: the official map prints ranges for several slots (CSC110/AA/AB 3-4, MAT220/221 4-5, FYE101/103 1-3, lab science 4-5, MAT230/231 4-5, CSC205++ 3-4, MAT240/241 4-5, CSC240/AA 3-4). This file encodes one valid official pathway using standard options (CSC 110 at 4, MAT 220/230/240 at 5, FYE 101 at 1, lab sciences at 4, CSC 205 at 4, CSC 240 at 3), summing to 70 credits. Official ranges are documented on each affected slot; the minimum-credit pathway totals 65. See an academic advisor. Prerequisite course codes not in this plan (MAT114, MAT115, MAT187, MAT188) are listed in external_prereqs; MAT12+/MAT15+ are district placement levels, not courses.
